introduction: This is the most technical part of the budget. We will analyze how the government's debt burden is measured and what different types of deficits reveal about the economy's health.

core_concepts.title: Revenue Deficit (RD)
core_concepts.description:
Shows that the government cannot even earn enough to cover its day-to-day running costs. 
Formula: $RD = 	ext{Revenue Expenditure} - 	ext{Revenue Receipts}$

core_concepts.title: Fiscal Deficit (FD)
core_concepts.description:
The most important indicator. It represents the total borrowing requirements of the government. 
Formula: $FD = 	ext{Total Expenditure} - (	ext{Revenue Receipts} + 	ext{Non-debt Capital Receipts})$ 
(In simple terms: Fiscal Deficit = Total Borrowing of the Government).

core_concepts.title: Primary Deficit (PD)
core_concepts.description:
Shows the deficit if we ignore the interest burden of past loans. It reflects the current government's performance. 
Formula: $PD = 	ext{Fiscal Deficit} - 	ext{Interest Payments}$

core_concepts.title: Effective Revenue Deficit (ERD)
core_concepts.description:
Introduced recently, it excludes grants given to states for 'creation of capital assets' from the Revenue Deficit. 
Formula: $ERD = 	ext{Revenue Deficit} - 	ext{Grants for Creation of Capital Assets}$

important_entities.name: FRBM Act, 2003
important_entities.significance: The Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act aims to limit the Fiscal Deficit to 3% of GDP and eliminate the Revenue Deficit. It acts as a legal check on government overspending.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: Is a High Fiscal Deficit Always Bad?
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Not necessarily. If the government borrows money to invest in infrastructure (Capital Formation), it can trigger future growth. However, if it borrows to pay for subsidies (Revenue Expenditure), it leads to a debt trap.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: FD is the Total Debt, PD is the Fresh Debt.
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Primary Deficit (PD) is considered 'purer' because it removes the burden of interest payments created by previous governments.

exam_strategy_tips: Write down the formulas and practice them. The equation 'Primary Deficit = Fiscal Deficit - Interest Payments' is a frequent numerical problem in Economics papers.
